We are waiting for the notification of the review committee by the end of December 2016 and to proceed with the next, which will consist of the development and submission of the full proposal.    -­‐ With the Head of the Department of Public Health Medicine, School of Public Health, University of Bielefeld in Germany, we are planning to initiate a collaborative clinical research after the end of my fellowship on Climate change and Infectious Diseases.  -­‐ With the Chief of the Department of the vaccines preventable diseases, Public Health Agency of Canada, we are planning a surveillance study of some vaccine preventable diseases in Burkina Faso.  -­‐ With the Head of Enteric Diseases of the “Agence the Médecine Preventive (AMP)”, Paris, France for opportunities for collaborative activities in the near future.    2.5 Attendance to International Meetings During our fellowship scheme we attended two international Meetings: -­‐ The “10th Vaccine Congress” from 4–7 September 2016 in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. The attendance at this congress is financially supported by WH0 – TDR.  The congress, focused on the vaccine science aim at bringing together the leading experts in the field of vaccinology to share the latest related information. I attended two workshops during this congress, one on the scientific publication “Publish or perish. How to Become a Successful Author” and the other on “How to raise funding for your research”. The attendance at this congress was an opportunity to get more familiarized with good practice in vaccinology, to expand my knowledge in vaccine sciences  -­‐ The 8th EDCTP Forum, from November 6–9, 2016, Lusaka, Zambia. The attendance to this Forum was granted by the EDCTP Scholarship.  We participated with a poster communication. The EDCTP Forum is one of the big conference to exchange ideas between scientist, policy makers and funders about the prevalent diseases in Africa such as malaria, HIV, tuberculosis, diarrheal diseases and the neglected tropical diseases. We attended several scientific presentations and workshop such as: Grant agreement preparation with EDCTP 2 (Organisers: EDCTP and Fit for Health 2.0), From Research to Publication (Organisers: British Medical Journal (BMJ, United Kingdom)).
